notes: SUB-STUDY. Page 1 reads verbatim: "This study H0P-MC-BP03 (NCT04874636) is a sub-study of Master Protocol H0P-MC-CPMP (NCT05986292)". The document is the intervention-specific appendix (ISA) BP03 to Master Protocol H0P-MC-CPMP (title page, p2), used together with the CLBP disease-state addendum (DSA). Only this document was used; nothing was filled from the master protocol or the DSA. Deferrals to the master protocol / CLBP DSA: the SoA itself (p8: 'Please refer to master protocol and the CLBP DSA SoAs for additional information'; SoA note T1:g1); objectives and endpoints (p6, p14); overall design (p15); eligibility criteria - SoA row 'Evaluate all I/E criteria' (p17; only LY3556050-specific criteria listed); lab tests (p27: 'The master protocol describes tests that may be performed at additional times noted in the SoA for this ISA. This table describes tests unique for this ISA.') - so the composition of SoA rows Hematology, Chemistry (beyond Cystatin-C and TSH), Lipid panel, Urine drug screen and Urine pregnancy is not in this document; questionnaires / standard tools (p13: 'As part of the master protocol, participants to this ISA will report their experiences using standard tools'); vital signs procedure details to the Manual of Operations (p23); AE/SAE (p23), concomitant therapy (p20), discontinuation (p22), statistics (p25) to the master protocol. Protocol version (rule 11): the PDF holds a single version - the original ISA ('Amendment Number: This is the original ISA', approval date 17-Mar-2021, p2); no amendments in the PDF. Text layer: most pages (p2, 4, 6-7, 9-11, 14-15, 19-21, 24-27) have a letter-spaced text layer (e.g. 'C he mistr y'); quotes and the abbreviation terms/definitions from p11 and p27 are copied in that spaced form so the checker can find them, while analytes, names and other field values are written as printed on the page image. No page reads '[no text layer on this page]'; p36 is an e-signature page. Rule 10: the lab-tests table on p27 (four columns: Chemistry, Additional Thyroid Tests, Other SST-Regulated Hormones, Other Tests) was checked on the page image; the text layer reads the rows across in the same order and the image confirmed every panel assignment (e.g. TSH and Cystatin-C under Chemistry; Serum pregnancy test, HbA1c and LY3556050 concentration under Other Tests). The separate Thyroid Safety Follow-Up table (p27) lists TSH in bold as its first row; recorded as an analyte. A CCI redaction box sits between the two tables. SoA page p10 was also viewed as an image (no change). No specimen or lab is stated for the lab panels. Laboratory setting: p33 (Appendix 3, exceptional circumstances only) 'Local laboratory testing may be conducted in lieu of central laboratory testing'; not recorded as a lab value for any activity. Conflicts / differences: ECG components differ between the SoA note (p9: PR interval, QRS duration and interval, heart rate) and Section 8.1.2 (p23: heart rate, PR, QRS, QT, QTcF) - both recorded as separate measurement entries. The serum pregnancy test is stated 'at the screening visit' (p29) while the ISA SoA marks Serum pregnancy at V4-V7 and ED (screening visits belong to the master/DSA SoA); recorded as printed. Instruments: empty. This ISA's SoA has no questionnaire or rating-scale rows; the Numeric Rating Scale (NRS) diary is mentioned only in visit procedures (p15, p16) and is not tied to an SoA activity here; questionnaires are deferred to the master protocol (p13). 'Participant returns device' has its note covered by a CCI redaction (SoA note T1:n19); the device is not described in the text. Cross-reference: Section 6.6 Dose Modification (p20) is found, but the starting dose level is blanked ('The starting dose level is' followed by redacted text) and the titration scheme itself is on p21, fully redacted (CCI). SoA rows the text does not describe: Hematology, Lipid panel, Urine drug screen (only 'Performed at investigator discretion'), Somatostatin-regulated hormone sample (the lab table heading 'Other SST-Regulated Hormones' (p27) is the nearest text but the protocol does not name the SoA row), Cystatin C and HbA1c (listed in the lab table only), Participant returns device (redacted). Intervention compliance is described in Section 6.4 (p20) as capsule counts recorded and reconciled, not a measurement. Thyroid follow-up: TSH >=10 at 2 consecutive visits triggers thyroid kit samples and thyroid ultrasound (p22). Abbreviations: Appendix 4 list (p35, 21 entries) plus the abbreviation lines under the SoA (p11) and the lab-tests table (p27). All tokens in SoA activity names (I/E, ECG, HbA1c, PK) are defined (p11/p27); none undefined. Other inline-defined abbreviations (e.g. HR on p13, BID/IMP/NIMP on p19, NRS p15, CRF p20) are not part of these lists and were not added. Redactions: CCI boxes on pp4, 6, 7 (schema), 9-11, 14 (objectives table), 15, 19-21, 24-27; PPD on p36. Updated 2026-11-07 to schema 1.1 (no re-extraction): instruments carry kind; letter-spaced abbreviation terms and definitions re-spaced (whitespace only, checked from page images).
